batch_prep.station: Sunday — Jalapeño Cheddar Egg Cups (12 min hands-on, 25 min in the Breville)
tasks: Heat the Breville to 350°F. Spray a 12-cup muffin tin hard, top surface included.
Brown 6 oz turkey sausage with 1/2 diced yellow onion, 5 min. Add 2 minced seeded jalapeños for the last minute. Drain.
Blend 8 whole eggs + 1 cup egg whites + 1 cup cottage cheese until fully smooth. Blending is what keeps them creamy, not rubbery.
Stir in smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper.
Divide the sausage across 12 cups, pour the egg blend over to 3/4 full, top with shredded cheddar.
Bake 22–25 min until set. Cool 5 min, knife around the edges, lift out. Keeps 5 days.
Austin: 4 cups + berries each morning. Cameron: 2 cups + 1/8 avocado.

batch_prep.station: Sunday — Chicken Tinga + Rice (20 min, covers Mon–Wed lunches)
tasks: Start 3 cups brown rice in the rice cooker. Hands off.
Quick pickle: thin-slice 1 red onion into a jar, cover with juice of 2 limes + salt + hot water. Ready in 30 min, lasts all week.
Blend 1 can fire-roasted tomatoes + 3 chipotles + 2 tbsp adobo + 4 garlic cloves + 2 tsp cumin + 1 tsp oregano.
Sauté 1 sliced yellow onion 4 min, add the sauce, simmer 5 min until it thickens.
Pull both rotisserie chickens. Save about 20 oz of plain meat for the panzanella. Fold the rest into the tinga.
Build 6 lunch containers. Austin x3: 3/4 c rice, 6 oz tinga, 1/2 c black beans, 1/4 c corn, pickled onion, cotija. Cameron x3: 1/3 c rice, 3.5 oz tinga, 1/4 c beans, pickled onion, light cotija.

batch_prep.station: Sunday — Char the Corn + Panzanella Base (15 min, covers Thu–Sun lunches)
tasks: Cut the kernels off 6 ears of corn. Dry-toast in a hot cast-iron skillet in batches, 4 min each, tossing once a minute, until blackened in spots. Four ears' worth goes to lunches, two to Tuesday's taco pico.
Shake vinaigrette: 3 tbsp red wine vinegar, 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp dijon, 1 grated garlic clove, salt, pepper.
Toss charred corn + 2 pints halved cherry tomatoes + 2 diced cucumbers + 1/2 sliced red onion with the vinaigrette.
Portion into 8 containers. Top with the reserved rotisserie chicken: Austin 6 oz, Cameron 3.5 oz.
CROUTONS STAY OUT. Bag them separately or they turn to mush. Feta and basil also go on at eating time.

batch_prep.station: Equipment note — the griddle is optional this week
tasks: Only Wednesday's smash burgers really want the Loco flat-top. Everything else runs on skillets, the Breville, and the air fryer.
If the griddle is already fired for burgers, the Friday shrimp and the Saturday vegetables work great on it too. Your call, not a requirement.
Total Sunday hands-on: about 45 min, and the Breville and rice cooker do half of it while you stand there.
Nothing below is locked to a night. Pick whatever sounds good.
Only real constraint: Thursday you're out.
Eat the tinga bowls Mon–Wed and the panzanella Thu–Sun. That order is about freshness, not preference.
Every dinner is self-contained and takes 25 minutes or less.

flexible_order: Days are a suggestion, not a schedule. All six dinners are independent — cook whichever one you feel like on any night. Only fixed point is Thursday out. Lunches are the one exception: the tinga bowls are built Sunday and should go first, the panzanella keeps better later in the week.
